title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells

entities.name: Yuma
entities.description: The narrator, a former Riveteer weaponsmith from New Capenna who fled to Thunder Junction and now owns a saloon with his cactusfolk friend Kirri.

entities.name: Elnor
entities.description: Yuma's former friend and fellow crew member, a charming fire-wielding woman who tracks him down for revenge over the stolen money.

entities.name: Shadress
entities.description: Elnor's girlfriend and a tailor in Yuma's old crew, calm and wise, who bought the building and is now dead.

entities.name: Kirri
entities.description: A baby cactusfolk Yuma found on Thunder Junction, who saved his life and conjures the vines that fill the bar.

entities.name: The snake demon
entities.description: A summoned snake demon coiled around Elnor's arm that breathes jets of flame.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A New Capenna gang of laborers that began as builders against the bosses and became just another set of bosses.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A New Capenna crime family whose muscle surrounded the crew on the train heist.

entities.name: Yuma's saloon
entities.description: Yuma's bar in Thunder Junction, run collectively, where the fight with Elnor takes place and where Kirri's vines grow.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The ruined, crime-ridden city plane that Yuma and Elnor come from.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A new plane still beginning, where Yuma has built a new life.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: The first city a traveler sees on Thunder Junction, where Yuma arrived.

entities.name: Thunder bow
entities.description: Yuma's heavy crossbow that channels lightning bolts.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals between planes that Yuma used to flee New Capenna.

entities.name: The New Capenna train heist
entities.description: A heist on a train in New Capenna, where Elnor fought off Brokers muscle, the beginning of the end for the crew.

events.summary: Elnor arrives at Yuma's bar with a fire-breathing snake demon on her arm and fires a warning shot of flame.
events.quote: The thing shot a jet of flame from its mouth, hot as a cremation in winter.

events.summary: Elnor demands to know where the money went, and Yuma retorts.
events.quote: "Where did the money go, Yuma?"

events.summary: In flashback, Yuma and Elnor team up with Shadress and others, leave the Riveteers and try to build a collective in an empty warehouse.
events.quote: We would leave the Riveteers, where we'd all spent our youth.

events.summary: In flashback, the squat's owner impounds their gear, so the crew turns to crime to pay the back rent.
events.quote: So, obviously, it would have to be crime, the main industry in New Capenna.

events.summary: In flashback, the crew blows safes and robs trains while Elnor charms guards and clerks.
events.quote: we blew safes and teased open vaults, we muscled our way through trains on rickety bridges.

events.summary: In flashback, the crew borrows money to buy a building, a decision that leads to layers of debt and enemies.
events.quote: We borrowed the money to buy it.

events.summary: Yuma runs off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.
events.quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

events.summary: Yuma throws a bottle at the snake demon and stuns it, then gets his thunder bow working.
events.quote: the bottle shattered against the creature, making its jet of fire blue for a second.

events.summary: Elnor says she has been hunting Yuma for a year and he says the money is gone.
events.quote: The money's gone. I spent it.

events.summary: In flashback, Yuma arrives in Omenport a year ago with the money sewn into his suit, walks into the desert and nearly dies of heat exhaustion.
events.quote: Heat exhaustion comes up on you unawares is what I've learned since then.

events.summary: In flashback, Yuma meets the baby cactusfolk Kirri, who leads him to a dry riverbed and saves his life.
events.quote: Low ground turned out to be a dry riverbed, cool water under the sand. So, I lived.

events.summary: Yuma reveals the money is the bar itself, which he runs with his staff as a collective.
events.quote: "Fine. I lied. It's not gone. You're standing in it."

events.summary: Elnor snaps her fingers and the fight resumes, with both of them missing and bottles being vaporized.
events.quote: She snapped her fingers; the snake came to attention.

events.summary: Yuma runs for the mezzanine and Elnor sets the staircase on fire behind him.
events.quote: she aimed calm as you please and set the stairs on fire behind me.

events.summary: Yuma blocks a jet of flame with his forearm, which is badly burned, while Kirri watches from a hole in the wall.
events.quote: I raised my forearm instinctively against the jet of flame, felt the fire hit it, and screamed in pain.

events.summary: Yuma recalls the train heist and realizes that Elnor now fights like Shadress, meaning Shadress is dead.
events.quote: She was fighting like Shadress .

events.summary: Yuma shatters the bar mirror with his thunder bow and fights Elnor hand to hand, throwing the snake demon off her.
events.quote: I fired my thunder bow at the long mirror behind the bar.

events.summary: A sudden desert rain puts out the fires, and Yuma pins Elnor, choosing not to kill her.
events.quote: And then I knelt on her sternum, grabbed her wrists, and it was done.

events.summary: Yuma tells Elnor the past is dead and that Thunder Junction is a place to invent yourself.
events.quote: "The past is dead," I said. "It's over."

events.summary: Kirri makes vines grow through the burnt saloon, filling the holes with red flowers.
events.quote: Kirri just invented them.

events.summary: Elnor concedes, retrieves her snake and leaves without looking back.
events.quote: She walked out without looking back.

relations.note: Kirri has saved Yuma's life twice and is his companion at the bar.
relations.quote: That little guy has saved my life twice.

relations.note: They were once friends in the same crew, now estranged.
relations.quote: We were friends once, Elnor and me.

relations.note: Elnor hunts Yuma for revenge over the stolen money.
relations.quote: But she was here for revenge, and I knew she wouldn't hold the next shot back.

relations.note: Yuma, Elnor and their friends left the Riveteers.
relations.quote: We would leave the Riveteers, where we'd all spent our youth.

relations.note: The snake demon is summoned and controlled by Elnor.
relations.quote: hate to do that to a demon who didn't ask to be summoned

relations.note: Kirri invented the vines that now cover the bar's interior.
